releases.notes:
# 0.5.4-vs2.3

For Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge, Valkyrien Skies 2.3, Create 0.5.1.j and Create Big Cannons 5.8.2.

## Cannon decorative bearing
- Fixed entity hitbox bounds and collision rotation to follow the linked cannon mount's pivot.

## VMod links
- Further improved scope cannon-link reliability by verifying and healing links when delivering primary and secondary cannon aim.
- Improved controller-hub recovery: ambiguous or unverified hubs are rejected instead of using a stale target. Relinking may be required when no unique valid hub can be identified.

## Scope controls
- Fixed DBW button and axis release calls.

The mount-handle fixes for nearby occupied seats and preservation of linked seats after ship AABB changes were already included in 0.5.3.

## Source code
The sources ZIP contains the tracked project source and build files from release commit 917c0564db2c66192a9f252fae61f38035506208, including the GPL-3.0 license. Reference mod dependencies are not bundled.
